title: Changes to a Tailwise Autoship Subscription: Frequency, Quantity, Item and Ship Date
content:
**Care desk guidance — changing a Tailwise Autoship subscription**

The customer may change the frequency, the quantity, the next ship date and, where the program allows an item swap, the item. The subscription status is pending first shipment, active, paused, payment hold or prescription hold when the change is requested, as the subscription record shows it.

## Cutoff

A change, skip or cancellation affects the upcoming shipment only if it is requested no later than the program's change cutoff days before the subscription's next ship date. The cutoff is counted in calendar days backward from the next ship date: a request dated exactly the cutoff number of days before the next ship date is in time, and a later request is late. A late change leaves the upcoming shipment as already scheduled and applies from the following one. The next ship date is read from the subscription record.

| Program cutoff | Next ship date | Request dated | In time for the upcoming shipment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 days (Autoship Fresh & Frozen) | a given Friday | the Monday before (4 days earlier) | Yes, exactly on the cutoff |
| 4 days | the same Friday | the Tuesday before (3 days earlier) | No: applies from the following shipment |
| 1 day (Autoship Everyday) | a given Wednesday | the Tuesday before | Yes |
| 1 day | the same Wednesday | that Wednesday | No |

## Limits on the new values

- A new frequency must respect the program's shortest frequency, longest frequency and frequency step.
- A new quantity may not exceed the program's most units per shipment.
- A new next ship date must fall on one of the program's ship weekdays and may not be earlier than the day after the request.

## Item swaps

A swap keeps the subscription, its shipment history and its discount standing; the new item's catalog price applies from the next shipment. A swap to an item of a different program is a cancellation plus a new enrollment. Pharmacy items cannot be swapped: a different medication needs a different prescription and a new subscription.

## Custom Meal Plan weight recalculation

For an Autoship Custom Meal Plan, when the pet's recorded weight differs from the plan's basis weight by at least the program's recalculation percent, the portions are recalculated, the plan's basis weight is reset to the current weight and the box quantity is updated; a smaller difference changes nothing.

| Hypothetical basis weight | Recorded weight now | Difference | With a 10 percent recalculation figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| 50.0 lb | 55.0 lb | 10 percent | Recalculated; basis weight becomes 55.0 lb |
| 50.0 lb | 45.0 lb | 10 percent | Recalculated; basis weight becomes 45.0 lb |
| 50.0 lb | 54.5 lb | 9 percent | No change |
